name: manual_a8b668
claim: Capability bearer credentials identify the control-plane proxy principal rather than individual human identity: out-of-band P5 approval evidence is strictly required for human-gated actions.

decisions.notes: Shared bearer tokens in Keychain or config prove application capability possession only; treating bearer resolution as proof of human presence violates the authenticated run contract addendum.

rationale: Shared bearer tokens in Keychain or config prove application capability possession only; treating bearer resolution as proof of human presence violates the authenticated run contract addendum.
